title: satsim-engine/1
description: Proposed. The engine block of a run-spec/1 document whose descriptor.origin.engine is satsim: a SatSim configuration run as authored (the pass-through form; the descriptor is opaque, {source: passthrough}). Rules this schema cannot express, enforced at admission by the SatSim adapter: the configuration reference resolves in the engine-asset library and its stamped digest matches (sha256 of a file, dirhash/1 of a directory holding exactly one config.yaml, config.yml or config.json); the configuration has exactly one of SatSim's roots (fpa, radar, passive_rf), one set (sim.samples 1 or absent), and, as a single file, names no other file; device is cpu (GPU behavior is unverified); the ephemeris and Earth-orientation assets are present with their pinned digests. The $id is an absolute URI under a base that does not resolve on the network (https://schemas.manifold.example/contracts/); a validator maps the base to manifold_contracts/.

mode.description: The engine form. Only the pass-through form exists: SatSim runs the configuration as authored.

config.description: The SatSim configuration: a library reference {name, content_hash} under the engine-asset library, a file (sha256) or a directory (dirhash/1) holding it.

seed.description: Seeds Python's random module, numpy's global state and TensorFlow's global seed before SatSim runs. Required: SatSim draws its star field and its noise from unseeded generators, so a run without it would not repeat. Part of the run spec, so part of the run id.

device.description: Where SatSim computes. Only cpu is admitted (the default); any other value is refused at admission because GPU behavior is unverified.
